# RealDays
> Unique experiences run by the local people who started them. In Victoria, Australia and Bali.

RealDays is a booking site for small, owner-run experience businesses. Nothing to join and nothing a month. Until 1 May 2027, businesses pay only the card fee on each booking, about 1.7% plus 30 cents for Australian cards. From 1 May 2027, it's 12% of each booking made through RealDays, with GST and the card fee included. If a booking is refunded in full, so is the fee. Bookings a business takes itself cost nothing. Businesses get at least 60 days' notice of any change and can leave whenever they want.

## Salty Cowboy, Bali
Owner-run horse rescue and riding centre in Bali, run by Simone. 11 experiences: beach and rice field rides, photoshoots, and lessons from grooming to a 3-day Horse Whisperer course. Prices from IDR 1,250,000.
- [Salty Cowboy](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/)
- [Beach & rice field ride](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/beach-ride/)
- [Insta ride](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/insta-ride/)
- [Beach photoshoot](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/beach-photoshoot/)
- [Horse grooming class](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/horse-grooming/)
- [Join Up lesson](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/join-up-lesson/)
- [Stable photoshoot](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/stable-photoshoot/)
- [Paddock photoshoot](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/paddock-photoshoot/)
- [Dressage masterclass](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/dressage-masterclass/)
- [Cottages photoshoot](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/cottages-photoshoot/)
- [Group clinic](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/group-clinic/)
- [Horse Whisperer course](https://getrealdays.com/bali/salty-cowboy/horse-whisperer-course/)

## Workshops and classes in Victoria, Australia
- [All experiences as JSON](https://getrealdays.com/experiences.json): one record per experience. Null means not confirmed.
- [Workshops and classes in Victoria](https://getrealdays.com/workshops/)
- [Workshops and classes in Melbourne](https://getrealdays.com/melbourne/)
- [Workshops in regional Victoria](https://getrealdays.com/regional-victoria/)

### Aysha Hansen, Newtown, Geelong
Perfume workshops in Newtown, Geelong, run by perfumer Aysha Hansen.
- [Make your own perfume in a Geelong atelier](https://getrealdays.com/aysha-hansen/): $199 to $249 AUD per person, 2 hours. Blend your own fragrance from 70 ingredients with perfumer Aysha Hansen.

### Indigo Woodworks, Indigo Valley
Woodworking courses in an off-grid workshop in the Indigo Valley, North East Victoria, run by Andy Hooke.
- [Four-Legged Milking Stool](https://getrealdays.com/indigo-woodworks/milking-stool/): $600 AUD per person, 2 full days, Saturday and Sunday. Build a four-legged stool from scratch over a weekend, for complete beginners.
- [Three Legged Perch Stool](https://getrealdays.com/indigo-woodworks/perch-stool/): $850 AUD per person, 3 full days. Shape and turn a three-legged perch stool over three days, for people with some woodworking experience.

### Peachy Keen Ceramics, Mount Eliza
Sunday ceramics sessions in a home studio in Mount Eliza.
- [Sunday afternoon in a ceramics studio](https://getrealdays.com/peachy-keen-ceramics/): $140 AUD per person, 2 hours. Make what you like in clay on a Sunday afternoon, with all materials and firings included.

### Suigeneris Atelier, Mulgrave
Leather-making classes at Sui Workshop, the class studio of Suigeneris Atelier in Mulgrave, Melbourne.
- [Couple Leather Pencil Case Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/couple-pencil-case/): $120 to $135 AUD per person, 3 hours. Make matching leather pencil cases for two and stamp your names on them.
- [Classic Card Holder Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/card-holder/): $120 AUD per person, 3 hours. Make a classic leather card holder and learn stitching, gluing and edge finishing.
- [French Bakery Leather Charm Making Class](https://getrealdays.com/suigeneris-atelier/bakery-charm/): $123 to $150 AUD per person, Baguette 2.5 to 3 hours, croissant 4 to 4.5 hours. Make a leather croissant or baguette charm in Italian leather, step by step.
